readerCopy.body: A difficult family or care conversation reaches the person with enough authority to change the arrangement. One disclosure about money, safety, resentment, or an old loyalty gives the family a chance to correct the problem before silence hardens around it again. The Moon pulls the emotional history into the open, while Pluto exposes who has controlled the information and the terms. The sextile opens a route toward a more honest agreement, but someone still has to name what the family has protected. The conversation can reduce the pressure because the real source of fear is no longer being managed through hints.
